When {npc:Amber} arrived in Rookgaard on her raft, she forgot her notebook. Fetch it from the chest on the dock east of the village and return it to her at the Academy: in exchange she gives you a {item:Short Sword}.
When Amber sailed to Rookgaard on her raft she forgot her {wiki:Amber's Notebook (Book)|notebook} and now she wants it back.
or you keep the notebook, if you do not trade it
Watch out for the {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders} near the dock: they poison and are dangerous for level 1–2 characters.

Leave the village of Rookgaard through the **east** exit and walk to the dock, on the coast east of the village ({coord:32172,32197,7}). On the way you may meet {creature:Bug|Bugs}, {creature:Spider|Spiders}, {creature:Wolf|Wolves} and especially {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders}.
**Use** the chest on the dock to receive a black book (Amber's notebook). Then walk back the same way, to the **west**, to the village.

Go back to the {wiki:Rookgaard Academy}, the building right **north** of the Rookgaard temple. Go down the stairs to the underground floor (1 floor down, where {npc:Paulie}'s bank is): {npc:Amber} is there, in the rest room beneath the Academy.
The Rookgaard Academy, north of the temple
Say {key:hi}, {key:book} and {key:yes} to {npc:Amber}. She keeps the notebook and gives you a {item:Short Sword}.
Only the book you picked up from the chest on the dock works, not just any other book.
To leave, go up the same stairs to the ground floor of the Academy; the temple is right to the south.

If you find black books that other players have thrown on the ground, you can trade them with Amber for more {item:Short Sword|Short Swords}. It comes in handy because {npc:Obi} pays some money for them.
